title: [P1] Rust frame-parser: support V2 signer_iid_present (bit 7)
description:
The Python link frame encoder sets bit 7 (signer_iid_present) for V2 frames with embedded signer IID. The Rust frame-parser binary rejects these with `ReservedBitSet` error.

## Test failure
`tests/sim/test_cross_impl_interop.py::TestPythonToRust::test_link_frame_interop_via_vectors`

## Vector
`broadcast_signed` in `link_frame.json`:
- `signer_iid_present: true`
- `signer_iid: de94eae2b97eac87`
- encoded[0] = 0x3f (includes 8-byte IID in body)

## Fix needed
Update Rust `lichen-link` frame parser to recognize bit 7 as `signer_iid_present` and parse the 8-byte IID field.
